message: Hi! I want to try a jiu jitsu class for myself. How do I start?
Hey! That's awesome. I'm Emma from Gracie Farmington Valley. We'd love to have you try a class! We offer a free trial for new students, no commitment required. What's your name?
Hi Emma! I'm Tester Quilo-0jlt7. I'm excited to give it a try!
Nice to meet you, Tester! So just to confirm, this is for you, right? You'll be the one taking the class?
Yes, that's right! I'll be the one taking the class.
Perfect! Can I grab your email address? It'll help us send you the class details and confirmation.
Got it! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Thanks! Last thing - what's your date of birth? Just helps us keep our records straight.

Awesome! Let's get you scheduled for your free trial. I have a few times available this week for Adult Fundamentals Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. How about Tuesday 7/7 at 7:30 PM, Wednesday 7/8 at 6:30 PM, or Thursday 7/9 at 7:30 PM?
Let’s go with Tuesday 7/7 at 7:30 PM! I'm really looking forward to it!

Perfect! You're all set for Tuesday, July 7th at 7:30 PM for your free trial class. We'll send a confirmation to your email. Just wear comfortable workout clothes and we'll take care of the rest. See you then!
